Container.Name: telegram-amazon-orders-returns
Container.Overview: Polls your own Amazon account for order, delivery, return, and transaction activity (via the unofficial amazon-orders library) and pushes updates to Telegram, including return drop-off QR codes. No web UI - interact through Telegram bot commands (/orders, /delivered, /transactions, /returns, /status). Optionally publishes active-orders/returns-in-progress/recent-deliveries counts to Home Assistant via MQTT.
Container.Description: Polls your own Amazon account for order and transaction activity and pushes updates to Telegram.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent Amazon session cookies and the sqlite tracking DB. Do not delete between restarts - the session is stored here.

Config.Name: Amazon Email
Config.Description: Amazon account email address to poll.

Config.Name: Telegram Chat ID
Config.Description: Your personal Telegram chat id (from @userinfobot). Only this chat is served.

Config.Name: Poll Interval Minutes
Config.Description: How often to poll Amazon for new orders/transactions, in minutes.

Config.Name: MQTT Host
Config.Description: Optional: MQTT broker hostname/IP, to publish order/return/delivery counts to Home Assistant. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: MQTT Topic Prefix
Config.Description: Topic prefix for published sensor values.

Config.Name: MQTT Retain
Config.Description: Retain published sensor values so Home Assistant has them immediately on restart. Discovery configs are always retained regardless.
